addSelf.description: Add yourself to the meeting (Default: false)

ForWeek.description:
The stored period key, in weeks since 1969-12-28, and the WEEK_ID of
`PUT /api/v1/measurables/{id}/week/{WEEK_ID}`. For a weekly score it numbers the
Sunday after the week in `Week` starts, not that week.

Week.description:
On the v2 score and scorecard routes, the first day (UTC) of the period Bloom shows this score
under, using the organization's week start; everywhere else, the stored `ForWeek` date.
Match a weekly, monthly or quarterly score to a week by `ForWeek`, not by date; daily
scores share one `ForWeek` per week, so match those by this date.

value.description: The score's new value. If null, score is deleted.
